title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
江西鄉試錄序
賢才有裨于
國家大矣凡科目以得士爲榮
自昔記之茲嘉靖辛酉江西
得士九十有五人將次第其
姓名幷錄其文二十一篇以
獻遵
===
成制也廷顯謬典試事例有言以
序簡端序曰都哉爾多士何
幸而奮庸于
明時哉又何幸而彙升于文明之
會哉維茲八月十日恭遇
聖皇萬壽之辰巡按御史叚顧言
率簾內外百執事稽首上
punctuated:
江西鄉試錄序

賢才有裨于國家大矣，凡科目以得士爲榮，自昔記之。茲嘉靖辛酉，江西得士九十有五人，將次第其姓名，幷錄其文二十一篇以獻，遵成制也。廷顯謬典試事，例有言以序簡端。序曰：都哉，爾多士！何幸而奮庸于明時哉！又何幸而彙升于文明之會哉！維茲八月十日，恭遇聖皇萬壽之辰，巡按御史叚顧言率簾內外百執事稽首上
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Jiangxi Provincial Examination

Worthy talent is of immense benefit to the state. In the examinations, the discovery of worthy scholars is held to be an honor, and records of it have been kept since ancient times. Now, in the xinyou year of Jiajing [1561], Jiangxi has selected ninety-five scholars. Their names are to be arranged in order, and twenty-one of their compositions recorded and presented to the throne, in accordance with established regulations. I, Tingxian, have undeservedly been entrusted with directing the examination. Custom requires some words as a preface at the beginning of the volume. The preface reads:

Splendid, you assembled scholars! How fortunate you are to put your abilities to work in an enlightened age! How fortunate, too, to advance together at this gathering of literary brilliance! On this tenth day of the eighth month, we reverently marked the sacred emperor’s birthday. Regional Inspector Duan Guyan led all the officials serving inside and outside the examination curtain in bowing their heads to the ground and offering up…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
萬年祝而是日適逢
景命丁卯夫丁位南有離明之義
焉夫卯位東於四德爲元而
天地生生無息之意胥此乎
貫焉以丁合卯而又年與日
會則
貞明貞觀之盛前古未有蓋
===
聖人久道之符天下文明之候也
爾多士正及是時而嚮用焉
躬熙明之
泰運遘
聖壽之昌期龍虎風雲若有所待
而然者詎偶爾哉傳謂
聖主隆興必有名世以佐其運乃
punctuated: 萬年祝，而是日適逢景命丁卯。夫丁位南，有離明之義焉；夫卯位東，於四德爲元，而天地生生無息之意胥此乎貫焉。以丁合卯，而又年與日會，則貞明貞觀之盛，前古未有，蓋聖人久道之符、天下文明之候也。爾多士正及是時而嚮用焉，躬熙明之泰運，遘聖壽之昌期，龍虎風雲若有所待而然者，詎偶爾哉？傳謂：「聖主隆興，必有名世以佐其運。」乃
translation_en:
… blessings for ten thousand years of life; and this very day coincided with the auspicious dingmao designation. Ding occupies the south and carries the meaning of brightness associated with the trigram Li. Mao occupies the east and, among the four virtues, corresponds to yuan, the originating virtue. The ceaseless generation of life by Heaven and Earth finds its meaning expressed throughout these correspondences. Ding combines with mao, and the year and day also coincide: such a flourishing of enduring brightness and enduring illumination has never existed in antiquity. It is surely a token of the sage’s enduring Way and a sign of civilization’s brilliance throughout the realm.
You assembled scholars have come precisely at this time to be received into service. You personally enjoy an age of radiant peace and encounter this flourishing season of the sage emperor’s longevity. Dragons and tigers, winds and clouds seem to have awaited something before coming together thus—could this be mere chance? The transmitted text says: “When a sage ruler rises to greatness, there must be men renowned in their age to assist the course of his reign.” Thus …

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
萬年祝而是日適逢
景命丁卯夫丁位南有離明之義
焉夫卯位東於四德爲元而
天地生生無息之意胥此乎
貫焉以丁合卯而又年與日
會則
貞明貞觀之盛前古未有蓋
===
聖人久道之符天下文明之候也
爾多士正及是時而嚮用焉
躬熙明之
泰運遘
聖壽之昌期龍虎風雲若有所待
而然者詎偶爾哉傳謂
聖主隆興必有名世以佐其運乃
punctuated:
萬年祝，而是日適逢景命丁卯。夫丁位南，有離明之義焉；夫卯位東，於四德爲元，而天地生生無息之意胥此乎貫焉。以丁合卯，而又年與日會，則貞明貞觀之盛，前古未有，蓋聖人久道之符、天下文明之候也。
爾多士正及是時而嚮用焉，躬熙明之泰運，遘聖壽之昌期，龍虎風雲，若有所待而然者，詎偶爾哉？傳謂：「聖主隆興，必有名世以佐其運。」乃
translation_en:
…wishes for ten thousand years of life; and this day happens to coincide with the august natal designation dingmao [?]. Ding occupies the south and carries the meaning of the brightness of the trigram Li; mao occupies the east and corresponds to origination among the four virtues. The ceaseless generation of life by Heaven and Earth runs through them both. Ding combines with mao, and the year and day coincide: thus the flourishing of steadfast illumination and contemplation has no precedent in antiquity. This is a token of the sage’s enduring Way and a sign of cultural brilliance throughout the realm.
You many scholars have come at precisely this time to be received into service. You personally enjoy this grand era of radiant enlightenment and encounter this flourishing season of the sage sovereign’s longevity. Dragons and tigers, winds and clouds—as though they had awaited something before coming together: could this be mere chance? The tradition says: “When a sage ruler rises to greatness, there must be men renowned in their age to assist his appointed course.” Now…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
惟大江之西固聲名文物奥
區文獻相續甲於海内迄今
舘閣侍從之臣爲心膂爲股
肱以上翊乎
聖皇配天無極之治夫固大雅開
先而鄉邦作程矣爾多士可
不以名世自期景行紹休思
===
===
以副
明良之際乎聞之至治之世天不
愛道地不愛寶以昭化理之
禎今我
皇上神聖同天中和總極而參兩
位育之効有以洋溢于寰宇
是以白鹿見神龜出靈芝生
punctuated:
惟大江之西，固聲名文物奥區，文獻相續，甲於海内。迄今舘閣侍從之臣，爲心膂，爲股肱，以上翊乎聖皇配天無極之治。夫固大雅開先，而鄉邦作程矣。爾多士可不以名世自期，景行紹休，思以副明良之際乎？
聞之，至治之世，天不愛道，地不愛寶，以昭化理之禎。今我皇上神聖同天，中和總極，而參兩位育之効，有以洋溢于寰宇。是以白鹿見，神龜出，靈芝生。
translation_en:
… Now the region west of the great Yangzi River, Jiangxi, has always been a heartland of renown and cultural accomplishment. Its succession of worthy men and learned traditions ranks foremost within the seas. Down to the present, its officials serving in the Hanlin Academy and other literary institutions and in attendance upon the throne have acted as the sovereign’s heart and backbone, his arms and legs, assisting our sagely emperor’s boundless governance, which matches Heaven. Indeed, these eminent men have led the way and established models for their native province. Can you, assembled scholars, fail to aspire to distinction in your age, emulate lofty conduct, carry forward this glory, and seek to live up to this meeting of an enlightened ruler and worthy ministers?
We have heard that, in an age of consummate governance, Heaven does not withhold its Way, nor Earth its treasures, thereby displaying auspicious signs of transformative rule. Now our emperor’s divine sagacity equals Heaven; through equilibrium and harmony he embraces the supreme standard. The effects of Heaven and Earth’s workings, expressed by three and two, and of all things attaining their proper places and nourishment, overflow throughout the world. Thus white deer appear, numinous tortoises emerge, and auspicious fungi grow.

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
卽鳥獸草木亦莫不各以其
文種種呈瑞以昭
穹蒼之殊貺矧茲江右惟我
皇祖廓清首及之地我
獻皇丕承過化之邦離麗文明爲
諸士漸被之所最先者又豈
無名世之士出於其間于以
===
瑞
盛世而光昭
聖人之神化矣乎稽之志粤維江
西古揚州域其星斗牛其分
野其屬吳楚閩越之交其形
勝咽扼荊淮翼控嶺表襟江
帶湖東南都會其俗比屋絃
punctuated:
卽鳥獸草木亦莫不各以其文，種種呈瑞，以昭穹蒼之殊貺。矧茲江右，惟我皇祖廓清首及之地，我獻皇丕承過化之邦，離麗文明，爲諸士漸被之所最先者，又豈無名世之士出於其間，于以瑞盛世而光昭聖人之神化矣乎？
稽之志，粤維江西，古揚州域。其星斗牛，其分野其屬吳楚閩越之交；其形勝，咽扼荊淮，翼控嶺表，襟江帶湖，東南都會；其俗，比屋絃……
translation_en:
…Even birds and beasts, plants and trees, all display auspicious signs of various kinds through their distinctive patterns, manifesting Heaven’s exceptional blessings. How much more must this be true of Jiangyou, among the first lands our imperial ancestor reached in his pacification, a region transformed by the passage of our Emperor Xian as he grandly assumed the succession. Illuminated by the brilliance of cultivated civilization, its scholars were among the first to receive that influence. Could there fail to emerge among them men renowned in their age, serving as auspicious signs of this flourishing era and brilliantly manifesting the sage ruler’s wondrous transforming power?
Consulting the gazetteer, we find that Jiangxi was anciently within the territory of Yangzhou. Its corresponding constellations are the Dipper and the Ox; its territorial divisions and affiliations place it at the junction of Wu, Chu, Min, and Yue [?]. Its strategic configuration commands the approaches to Jing and Huai like a throat and controls the lands beyond the mountain passes like outspread wings. With rivers as its lapels and lakes as its girdle, it is a metropolitan center of the southeast. As for its customs, in house after house stringed instruments…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
誦其人風流儒雅其往哲則
徐穉陶潛歐陽脩與夫曾陸
諸賢後先輝映肆我
國朝稱甚盛焉此其故何哉蓋
江以西氣龐土厚其產惟稻
麥綿枲無異物奇貨之紛華
而名山秀水之精英獨產于
===
士其士惟惇樸務實惟本經
術為舉業素風質行傳自哲
先以迄於今爾多士應時而
出暉光時發夫固有所自來
矣是故觀于其文而人可知
也夫文有氣勢宏放吞吐湖
江如英雲流空而頃息萬狀
punctuated: 誦，其人風流儒雅。其往哲則徐穉、陶潛、歐陽脩與夫曾、陸諸賢，後先輝映。肆我國朝，稱甚盛焉。此其故何哉？蓋江以西，氣龐土厚，其產惟稻麥綿枲，無異物奇貨之紛華，而名山秀水之精英獨產于士。其士惟惇樸務實，惟本經術為舉業。素風質行，傳自哲先，以迄於今。爾多士應時而出，暉光時發，夫固有所自來矣。是故觀于其文，而人可知也。夫文有氣勢宏放，吞吐湖江，如英雲流空而頃息萬狀，
translation_en: …recitation; its people are cultivated, refined, and learned. Among its worthies of earlier ages were Xu Zhi, Tao Qian, Ouyang Xiu, and the various sages of the Zeng and Lu families, whose brilliance shone forth in succession. Under our reigning dynasty, this flourishing of talent has been particularly celebrated. Why is this so? The region west of the river has abundant vital energies and rich soil. Its products are simply rice, wheat, cotton, and hemp, without the dazzling profusion of exotic objects and rare merchandise. Instead, the finest essence of its famed mountains and beautiful waters finds expression solely in its scholars. These scholars are earnest and unassuming, devoted to practical substance; they base their preparation for the examinations on classical learning. Their plain ways and substantial conduct have been handed down from earlier sages to the present. You many scholars emerge as the times demand, your brilliance shining forth from time to time: surely this has deep origins. Thus, by examining their writing, one can know the men themselves. There is writing whose force is expansive and unrestrained, swallowing and disgorging lakes and rivers, like splendid clouds streaming across the sky and assuming ten thousand forms in an instant…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
者其洪都之士乎有意態高
遠底裏洞徹如深秋止水而
毫髮可鑑者其秀江之士乎
有雄若怒猊抉石而步驟則
良馬馳風磬控有調而又有
凌冲牛斗之意其劔江之士
乎有局調儁逸如奇葩秀草
===
色色燁目而起伏突兀則又
搏海鵬而翻健翮也其廬陵
之士乎有思慮沈澄空涵冰
玉風槩掀揭而騫摩九霄者
其彭匡之士乎有節度整裁
如老將用兵而刁斗不聞又
有波瀾縈廻之中沛乎寓一
punctuated: 者，其洪都之士乎？有意態高遠，底裏洞徹，如深秋止水而毫髮可鑑者，其秀江之士乎？有雄若怒猊抉石，而步驟則良馬馳風，磬控有調，而又有凌冲牛斗之意，其劔江之士乎？有局調儁逸，如奇葩秀草，色色燁目，而起伏突兀，則又搏海鵬而翻健翮也，其廬陵之士乎？有思慮沈澄，空涵冰玉，風槩掀揭，而騫摩九霄者，其彭匡之士乎？有節度整裁，如老將用兵而刁斗不聞，又有波瀾縈廻之中，沛乎寓一
translation_en: …might these be the scholars of Hongdu? There are those whose conceptions are lofty and far-reaching, whose inner substance is transparently clear, like still water in late autumn in which even the finest hair can be discerned: might these be the scholars of Xiujiang? There are those whose vigor resembles an enraged lion rending rocks, yet whose pacing resembles a fine horse racing with the wind, its reins handled in measured rhythm [?], and who also aspire to soar into the constellations of the Ox and the Dipper: might these be the scholars of Jianjiang? There are those whose composition and cadence are outstanding and untrammeled, like rare blossoms and elegant grasses, every hue dazzling the eye; in their abrupt rises and falls, they are also like the great peng bird beating the sea and spreading its powerful wings: might these be the scholars of Luling? There are those whose thoughts are deep and limpid, an open expanse holding ice and jade, whose bearing rises grandly, soaring to brush the highest heavens: might these be the scholars of Pengkuang? There are those whose organization is disciplined and precisely ordered, like a seasoned general deploying troops without a sound from the night-watch cauldrons, and who, amid winding waves, also contain the surging force of a single…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
瀉千里之狀者其建武臨川
之士乎是士之毓靈於山川
者罔不發而爲文章殆彬彬
郁郁莫之尚也已詩曰維嶽
降神生甫及申又曰保玆天
子生仲山甫爾多士可知厚
以自待而炳名世之業矣夫
===
士之利治視金之利用一也
惟玆多士之進也歲迫辛酉
夫辛爲金象酉宮亦宅金焉
稽諸方位江之西正爲應之
是天地粹美之會也以是地
而求才是謂地產而利器作
以是歲而得才是謂天畀而
punctuated:
瀉千里之狀者，其建武臨川之士乎？是士之毓靈於山川者，罔不發而爲文章，殆彬彬郁郁，莫之尚也已。《詩》曰：「維嶽降神，生甫及申。」又曰：「保玆天子，生仲山甫。」爾多士可知厚以自待，而炳名世之業矣。

夫士之利治，視金之利用一也。惟玆多士之進也，歲迫辛酉。夫辛爲金象，酉宮亦宅金焉。稽諸方位，江之西正爲應之，是天地粹美之會也。以是地而求才，是謂地產而利器作；以是歲而得才，是謂天畀而
translation_en:
…with the force of a torrent pouring a thousand li: are these not the scholars of Jianwu [?] and Linchuan? The numinous gifts these scholars have drawn from the mountains and rivers all find expression in their writing. So refined and richly accomplished is it that scarcely anything could surpass it. The Book of Odes says: “The sacred peaks sent down their spirits, giving birth to Fu and Shen.” It also says: “To protect this Son of Heaven, Zhongshan Fu was born.” You assembled scholars should therefore recognize that you must set high expectations for yourselves and bring lustre to achievements that will make you renowned in your age.

The usefulness of scholars in government is like the usefulness of metal in practical service. Now, as these many scholars advance, the year draws near to xinyou. Xin symbolizes Metal, and the position you is also Metal’s abode. Examining the directional correspondences, we find that Jiangxi, west of the river, corresponds precisely to it. Here the purest excellences of Heaven and Earth converge. To seek talent in this land is what is meant by saying that the earth produces its materials and useful instruments are fashioned; to obtain talent in this year is what is meant by saying that Heaven bestows its gifts and…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
利器成兩儀發其秀于爾多
士在爾多士果能運精吐竒
相期効用于
聖明玉燭金甌之化上也依
日月之華賛思
密勿以奠九鼎次而摛文振藻
綸渙金聲如鳴球在
===
庭鏗鏘中節又或紓棻理錯如
工師執藝操斧削墨成九廈
之廣飾輪轅之庸保釐鎖鑰
民賴金湯在內爲柱石鼎鼐
之臣在外爲封疆甲冑之臣
粹君子如金之德展傅相作
礪之猷懋庸樹烈將以流聲
punctuated: 利器成。兩儀發其秀于爾多士，在爾多士果能運精吐竒，相期効用于聖明玉燭金甌之化上也。依日月之華，賛思密勿，以奠九鼎；次而摛文振藻，綸渙金聲，如鳴球在庭，鏗鏘中節；又或紓棻理錯，如工師執藝，操斧削墨，成九廈之廣，飾輪轅之庸，保釐鎖鑰，民賴金湯。在內爲柱石鼎鼐之臣，在外爲封疆甲冑之臣，粹君子如金之德，展傅相作礪之猷，懋庸樹烈，將以流聲
translation_en: …and useful instruments are perfected. Heaven and earth bring forth their finest essence in you, assembled scholars. It rests with you truly to put that essence to work and express extraordinary talents, encouraging one another to serve the sage and enlightened sovereign’s rule, harmonious as the seasons and secure as a golden vessel. Drawing upon the radiance of sun and moon, assist him with thoughtful, diligent service, thereby securing the Nine Tripods, emblems of dynastic sovereignty. Next, deploy your literary gifts and display your eloquence, giving imperial pronouncements a bronze-like resonance, like jade chimes sounding in the court, their ringing perfectly in measure. Or unravel tangled growth and bring order to complexities [?], as master craftsmen exercise their skills, wielding axes and hewing to the ink line, to complete the breadth of nine great halls and furnish wheels and shafts for use. Govern and safeguard strategic strongholds, so that the people may rely upon walls of metal and moats of boiling water. At court, become ministers who are pillars and foundation stones, who harmonize affairs as food is blended in the great cooking vessels; beyond the court, become armored ministers defending the frontiers. Refine the gentleman’s virtue, pure as metal, and carry out Minister Fu Yue’s purpose of serving as a whetstone for his sovereign. Strive in service and establish illustrious achievements, so that your renown may spread…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
施顯當世策名于
清廟明堂勒勳于太常竹帛務與
丁酉得仁傑辛巳得九齡媲
譽而並光焉俾後之論賛
中興賢佐名世殊勛者有所歸
美則諸士精英垂之永永斯
無負天之所篤生也治化之
===
所陶成也山川之所鍾靈也
御史暨百執事亦光遠而有
耀矣如或不自鎔鑄不以名
節自愛而雜銅錫以為金詒
主人而沽之則它日必有嗤
是舉非沽真金者矣夫辛者
新也雅以太歲在辛為恒光
punctuated:
施顯當世，策名于清廟明堂，勒勳于太常竹帛，務與丁酉得仁傑、辛巳得九齡媲譽而並光焉。俾後之論賛中興賢佐、名世殊勛者有所歸美，則諸士精英垂之永永，斯無負天之所篤生也、治化之所陶成也、山川之所鍾靈也。御史暨百執事亦光遠而有耀矣。如或不自鎔鑄，不以名節自愛，而雜銅錫以為金，詒主人而沽之，則它日必有嗤是舉非沽真金者矣。
夫辛者，新也。雅以太歲在辛為恒光，
translation_en:
…and make their renown manifest in the present age, inscribe their names in the pure ancestral temple and the Hall of Light, and have their achievements recorded on the bamboo slips and silk of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. They must strive to rival in reputation and shine alongside the dingyou year's discovery of Renjie and the xinsi year's discovery of Jiuling. Thus, when later generations discuss and praise the worthy assistants of the restoration and the exceptional achievements that distinguished this age, they will have those to whom they can attribute its glory. The excellence of these gentlemen will then endure forever. They will not have failed the Heaven that so generously gave them birth, the civilizing governance that molded them, or the mountains and rivers whose spiritual potency is concentrated in them. The Censor and all the officials engaged in this undertaking will likewise shine far into the future.
If, however, they do not refine and mold themselves, or cherish their reputations and integrity, but instead mix copper and tin and pass it off as gold, deceiving the buyer into purchasing it, then some future observer will surely scoff that this examination did not purchase genuine gold.
Now xin means “new.” The Ya states that when Tai Sui is in xin, it is called “constant radiance” [?]…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
日新之謂也酉者有也淮南
子以招搖在酉爲萬寶告成
富有之謂也富有之謂大業
日新之謂盛德蓋盛德大業
我
皇上聖神功化之極也爾多士遭
此
===
===
明盛之時尚思所以慎圖之是舉
也釐之規畫以貞其度兼總
百執而告虔事事者御史段
顧言也其修禮馳聘克敦懿
典飭紀慎防而以嚴以翼者
布政司左布政使曹忭右參
政王應時按察司副使浦之
punctuated:
日新之謂也。酉者，有也。《淮南子》以招搖在酉爲萬寶告成，富有之謂也。富有之謂大業，日新之謂盛德。蓋盛德大業，我皇上聖神功化之極也。爾多士遭此明盛之時，尚思所以慎圖之。
是舉也，釐之規畫以貞其度，兼總百執而告虔事事者，御史段顧言也。其修禮馳聘，克敦懿典，飭紀慎防而以嚴以翼者，布政司左布政使曹忭、右參政王應時、按察司副使浦之
translation_en:
…means daily renewal. You 酉 means “having.” The Huainanzi takes the Dipper’s handle pointing to you as signifying that the myriad treasures have reached completion: this means abundant possession. “Abundant possession is called great achievement; daily renewal is called flourishing virtue.” Flourishing virtue and great achievement are the culmination of our Emperor’s sagely and divine accomplishments and transforming influence. You scholars, having encountered this enlightened and flourishing age, should consider how to plan your course with care.
For this examination, the man who arranged its planning to establish proper standards, oversaw all the functionaries, and devoted himself reverently to every task was Censor Duan Guyan. Those who observed the formalities and dispatched invitations, faithfully upheld the excellent established practices, enforced discipline and maintained careful safeguards, acting with rigor and reverence, were Cao Bian, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of the Provincial Administration Commission; Wang Yingshi, Right Administration Vice Commissioner; and Pu Zhi…, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of the Provincial Surveillance Commission…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
浩僉事盧岐嶷也其分經以
校而又協恭以將者以校易
則金鸞黎永清劉晉以校書
則周希文郭從義以校詩則
廷顯與張佐古養敬朱應隆
以校春秋則蔡應陽許尚靜
以校禮記則汪仲川而廷顯
===
===
與應陽則總正其事者也其
糊名易書剔姦證誤而服勞
承采於簾之外者百執事者
責也其甄拔多士而冀得真
才者提學副使黃國卿事也
其應試士凡四千七百有奇
者其才蔚也而實我
punctuated:
浩、僉事盧岐嶷也。其分經以校，而又協恭以將者：以校《易》，則金鸞、黎永清、劉晉；以校《書》，則周希文、郭從義；以校《詩》，則廷顯與張佐、古養敬、朱應隆；以校《春秋》，則蔡應陽、許尚靜；以校《禮記》，則汪仲川。而廷顯與應陽，則總正其事者也。
其糊名易書、剔姦證誤，而服勞承采於簾之外者，百執事者責也。其甄拔多士而冀得真才者，提學副使黃國卿事也。其應試士凡四千七百有奇者，其才蔚也，而實我
translation_en:
…Pu Zhihao and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Lu Qiyi. Those who divided the Classics among themselves for assessing the papers and cooperated respectfully in conducting the work were: for the Book of Changes, Jin Luan, Li Yongqing, and Liu Jin; for the Book of Documents, Zhou Xiwen and Guo Congyi; for the Book of Odes, Tingxian, Zhang Zuo, Gu Yangjing, and Zhu Yinglong; for the Spring and Autumn Annals, Cai Yingyang and Xu Shangjing; and for the Book of Rites, Wang Zhongchuan. Tingxian and Yingyang exercised overall supervision of this work.
Sealing candidates’ names, transcribing their papers, rooting out fraud, checking errors, and laboring to carry out instructions outside the curtain separating the examiners from the administrative staff were the responsibilities of the various examination functionaries. Selecting from among the many scholars in the hope of finding true talent was the responsibility of Huang Guoqing, Education Intendant and Surveillance Vice Commissioner. Altogether, more than four thousand seven hundred scholars sat the examination: such was the abundance of talent, and this was truly the result of our …

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
皇上壽考作人之効也乃若總督
浙直等處軍務太子太保兵
部尚書兼都察院右都御史
胡宗憲宣鬯
威靈聲烈四訖廼茲節制攸及則
宣猷靖氛文教其允賴也其
江西巡撫右副都御史張元
===
冲允釐輯寧式程丕美提督
南贛等處軍務右副都御史
先任楊伊志今陞陸穩控扼疆
里胥茂底綏其絲綸保乂人而
崇士者俱也先期以遷秩行
者則左布政使蔡汝楠右布
政使王宗沐左參議孫應鰲
punctuated: 皇上壽考作人之効也。乃若總督浙直等處軍務、太子太保、兵部尚書兼都察院右都御史胡宗憲，宣鬯威靈，聲烈四訖。廼茲節制攸及，則宣猷靖氛，文教其允賴也。其江西巡撫、右副都御史張元冲，允釐輯寧，式程丕美。提督南贛等處軍務、右副都御史，先任楊伊志，今陞陸穩，控扼疆里，胥茂底綏。其絲綸保乂人而崇士者俱也。先期以遷秩行者，則左布政使蔡汝楠、右布政使王宗沐、左參議孫應鰲
translation_en:
…the result of His Majesty’s nurturing men of talent over his long life. As for Hu Zongxian, Supreme Commander of Military Affairs in Zhejiang, the Metropolitan Region, and Other Areas, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of War concurrently serving as Right Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, he has spread the imperial majesty abroad, and his renown and achievements have reached the four quarters. Wherever his military authority extends, he propagates imperial policies and quells disturbances; cultural instruction truly depends upon him.

Zhang Yuanchong, Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, has effectively administered affairs and secured peace, establishing a model of great excellence. The Right Vice Censors-in-Chief charged with directing military affairs in Nan’an, Ganzhou, and Other Areas—the former incumbent Yang Yizhi and the newly promoted Lu Wen—have guarded strategic points throughout the territory and both achieved outstanding success in securing peace. Under imperial commands, they all protect and govern the people while honoring scholars [?].

Those who departed before the appointed time because of promotion were Cai Runan, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner; Wang Zongmu, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner; and Sun Ying’ao, Left Assistant Administration Commissioner…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
僉事鄭述以奉
表行者則右叅政吳三樂副使
陳惟舉署都指揮僉事宣詔
夙展襄績具存風勸而右叅
政趙鏘左叅議王詠右叅議
楊守魯副使陶承學陳柯季
德甫僉事李正彞署都指揮
===
僉事段以鳳王瑞則綜理籌
諮均勞匪懈者也維時奉
朝命有司玆土者以憲臣則都察
院左副都御史鄢懋卿肅紀
振風譽髦端軌以部臣則戶
部郎中錢邦偁林烈主事袁
隨楊進道刑部主事陸一鵬
punctuated:
僉事鄭述。以奉表行者，則右叅政吳三樂、副使陳惟舉、署都指揮僉事宣詔，夙展襄績，具存風勸。而右叅政趙鏘、左叅議王詠、右叅議楊守魯、副使陶承學、陳柯、季德甫、僉事李正彞、署都指揮僉事段以鳳、王瑞，則綜理籌諮，均勞匪懈者也。
維時，奉朝命有司玆土者，以憲臣則都察院左副都御史鄢懋卿，肅紀振風，譽髦端軌；以部臣則戶部郎中錢邦偁、林烈，主事袁隨、楊進道，刑部主事陸一鵬，
translation_en:
…and Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Zheng Shu. Those who departed to present a memorial to the throne were Right Administration Vice Commissioner Wu Sanle, Surveillance Vice Commissioner Chen Weiju, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner Xuan Zhao. They had already rendered assistance of proven merit, leaving examples that inspired and encouraged others. Right Administration Vice Commissioner Zhao Qiang, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner Wang Yong, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Yang Shoulu, Surveillance Vice Commissioners Tao Chengxue, Chen Ke, and Ji Defu, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Li Zhengyi, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Duan Yifeng and Wang Rui managed the arrangements, planned, and consulted, sharing the toil without flagging.
At this time, among those serving in this territory under imperial orders, the censorial official was Yan Maoqing, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, who enforced discipline, invigorated moral standards, commended outstanding talent, and rectified the standards of conduct. The ministry officials were Qian Bangcheng and Lin Lie, Directors in the Ministry of Revenue; Yuan Sui and Yang Jindao, Secretaries in that ministry; and Lu Yipeng, Secretary in the Ministry of Justice…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
南京兵部主事劉穩以行人
司則行人嚴從簡楊標吳教
傳孫汝翼李琦以錦衣衛則
千戶王正億李鉉俱雅意人
文而樂觀盛美者也其得兼
書者例也
廣東惠州府歸善縣儒學教
===
諭林廷顯謹序
punctuated:
南京兵部主事劉穩；以行人司，則行人嚴從簡、楊標、吳教傳、孫汝翼、李琦；以錦衣衛，則千戶王正億、李鉉，俱雅意人文而樂觀盛美者也。其得兼書者，例也。
廣東惠州府歸善縣儒學教諭林廷顯謹序。
translation_en:
…Liu Wen, a Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of War; from the Office of Messengers, the Messengers Yan Congjian, Yang Biao, Wu Jiaochuan, Sun Ruyi, and Li Qi; and from the Embroidered-uniform Guard, the Chiliarchs Wang Zhengyi and Li Xuan—all cherished literary culture and delighted in witnessing this splendid occasion. Their inclusion here alongside the others follows established precedent.
Respectfully composed as a preface by Lin Tingxian, Instructor at the Confucian School of Guishan County, Huizhou Prefecture, Guangdong.

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖四十年江西鄉試
監臨官
巡按江西監察御史段顧言〔汝行順天府遵化縣籍山西臨汾縣人庚戌進士〕
提調官
江西等處承宣布政使司左布政使曹忭〔子誠湖廣江陵縣人辛丑進士〕
江西等處承宣布政使司右參政王應時〔懋行福建候官縣人庚戌進士〕
監試官
江西等處提刑按察司副使浦之浩〔子化山東登州衛籍直隸嘉定縣人辛丑進士〕
江西等處提刑按察司僉事盧岐嶷〔希稷福建長泰縣人甲辰進士〕
===
考試官
廣東惠州府歸善縣儒學教諭林廷顯〔斯徳福建閩縣籍福清縣人壬子貢士〕
浙江衢州府江山縣儒學教諭蔡應陽〔升之湖廣麻城縣人戊午貢士〕
同考試官
浙江嘉興府崇德縣儒學教諭金鸞〔應祥南京豹韜衛籍直隸定遠縣人乙卯貢士〕
福建泉州府南安縣儒學教諭周希文〔宗仁廣西宜山縣人乙卯貢士〕
廣西梧州府懷集縣儒學教諭張佐〔子敬福建莆田縣人丙午貢士〕
河南河南府宜陽縣儒學教諭古養敬〔子修四川酆都縣人己酉貢士〕
福建福州府連江縣儒學教諭許尚靜〔原仁廣東饒平縣人己酉貢士〕
punctuated:
嘉靖四十年江西鄉試

監臨官
巡按江西監察御史段顧言〔汝行，順天府遵化縣籍，山西臨汾縣人，庚戌進士〕。

提調官
江西等處承宣布政使司左布政使曹忭〔子誠，湖廣江陵縣人，辛丑進士〕。
江西等處承宣布政使司右參政王應時〔懋行，福建候官縣人，庚戌進士〕。

監試官
江西等處提刑按察司副使浦之浩〔子化，山東登州衛籍，直隸嘉定縣人，辛丑進士〕。
江西等處提刑按察司僉事盧岐嶷〔希稷，福建長泰縣人，甲辰進士〕。

考試官
廣東惠州府歸善縣儒學教諭林廷顯〔斯徳，福建閩縣籍，福清縣人，壬子貢士〕。
浙江衢州府江山縣儒學教諭蔡應陽〔升之，湖廣麻城縣人，戊午貢士〕。

同考試官
浙江嘉興府崇德縣儒學教諭金鸞〔應祥，南京豹韜衛籍，直隸定遠縣人，乙卯貢士〕。
福建泉州府南安縣儒學教諭周希文〔宗仁，廣西宜山縣人，乙卯貢士〕。
廣西梧州府懷集縣儒學教諭張佐〔子敬，福建莆田縣人，丙午貢士〕。
河南河南府宜陽縣儒學教諭古養敬〔子修，四川酆都縣人，己酉貢士〕。
福建福州府連江縣儒學教諭許尚靜〔原仁，廣東饒平縣人，己酉貢士〕。
translation_en:
Jiangxi Provincial Examination, the Fortieth Year of Jiajing (1561)

Supervising Official
Duan Guyan, Investigating Censor on巡 inspection duty in Jiangxi, courtesy name Ruxing, was registered in Zunhua County, Shuntian Prefecture, and was a native of Linfen County, Shanxi. He became a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) in the gengxu year.

Proctors
Cao Bian, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Jiangxi, courtesy name Zicheng, was a native of Jiangling County, Huguang. He became a metropolitan graduate in the xinchou year.
Wang Yingshi, Right Administration Vice Commissioner of Jiangxi, courtesy name Maoxing, was a native of Houguan County, Fujian. He became a metropolitan graduate in the gengxu year.

Examination Monitoring Officials
Pu Zhihao, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Jiangxi, courtesy name Zihua, was registered with the Dengzhou Guard in Shandong and was a native of Jiading County, Zhili. He became a metropolitan graduate in the xinchou year.
Lu Qiyi, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner of Jiangxi, courtesy name Xiji, was a native of Changtai County, Fujian. He became a metropolitan graduate in the jiachen year.

Examiners
Lin Tingxian, Instructor at the Confucian School of Guishan County, Huizhou Prefecture, Guangdong, courtesy name Side, was registered in Min County, Fujian, and was a native of Fuqing County. He became a tribute scholar (gongshi) in the renzi year.
Cai Yingyang, Instructor at the Confucian School of Jiangshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, courtesy name Shengzhi, was a native of Macheng County, Huguang. He became a tribute scholar in the wuwu year.

Associate Examiners
Jin Luan, Instructor at the Confucian School of Chongde County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, courtesy name Yingxiang, was registered with the Baotao Guard in Nanjing and was a native of Dingyuan County, Zhili. He became a tribute scholar in the yimao year.
Zhou Xiwen, Instructor at the Confucian School of Nan’an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, courtesy name Zongren, was a native of Yishan County, Guangxi. He became a tribute scholar in the yimao year.
Zhang Zuo, Instructor at the Confucian School of Huaiji County, Wuzhou Prefecture, Guangxi, courtesy name Zijing, was a native of Putian County, Fujian. He became a tribute scholar in the bingwu year.
Gu Yangjing, Instructor at the Confucian School of Yiyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan, courtesy name Zixiu, was a native of Fengdu County, Sichuan. He became a tribute scholar in the jiyou year.
Xu Shangjing, Instructor at the Confucian School of Lianjiang County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, courtesy name Yuanren, was a native of Raoping County, Guangdong. He became a tribute scholar in the jiyou year.

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
直隸鳳陽府壽州霍丘縣儒學教諭汪仲川〔子東湖廣黃岡縣人乙卯貢士〕
山東濟南府章丘縣儒學教諭郭從義〔集之河南鈞州人癸卯貢士〕
福建福州府古田縣儒學教諭黎永清〔子節廣西蒼梧縣人壬子貢士〕
直隸寧國府南陵縣儒學教諭朱應隆〔仲豫浙江慈谿縣人戊午貢士〕
廣東高州府茂名縣儒學教諭劉晉〔明之廣西靈川縣人己酉貢士〕
印卷官
江西等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷錢遜〔禮卿直隸丹徒縣人監生〕
江西等處提刑按察司經歷司知事毛炳〔叔文浙江鄞縣人監生〕
收掌試卷官
===
南昌府知府韓弼〔汝良浙江平湖縣籍餘姚縣人丁未進士〕
饒州府知府王健〔干行福建漳浦縣人丁未進士〕
臨江府知府謝鵬舉〔仲南湖廣蒲圻縣人癸丑進士〕
南康府知府吳炳庶〔朝徹浙江仙居縣人庚戌進士〕
受卷官
袁州府知府周璞〔元治浙江德清縣人丁未進士〕
瑞州府知府韓子允〔明仲浙江慈谿縣人丁未進士〕
建昌府知府鄧廷猷〔汝嘉湖廣蒲圻縣人癸丑進士〕
撫州府知府陳元琰〔仲文福建懷安縣人庚戌進士〕
punctuated:

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
所求乎臣以事君未能也
畏天命畏大人畏聖人之言
奮乎百世之上百世之下聞者莫不興起
也
易
與日月合其明
是以順乎天而應乎人
===
自天祐之吉无不利子曰祐者助也天之
所助者順也
兼三才而兩之故六
書
夔曰戛擊鳴球搏拊琴瑟以詠祖考來格
虞賓在位羣后德讓下管鼗鼓合止柷
敔笙鏞以間鳥獸蹌蹌簫韶九成鳳凰
來儀夔曰於予擊石拊石百獸率舞庶
尹允諧
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

所求乎臣以事君，未能也。
畏天命，畏大人，畏聖人之言。
奮乎百世之上，百世之下，聞者莫不興起也。

易

與日月合其明。
是以順乎天而應乎人。
自天祐之，吉，无不利。子曰：「祐者，助也。天之所助者，順也。」
兼三才而兩之，故六。

書

夔曰：「戛擊鳴球，搏拊琴瑟以詠，祖考來格，虞賓在位，羣后德讓。下管鼗鼓，合止柷敔，笙鏞以間，鳥獸蹌蹌。簫韶九成，鳳凰來儀。」夔曰：「於！予擊石拊石，百獸率舞，庶尹允諧。」
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“What I require of a minister, I have not yet been able to accomplish in serving my ruler.”

“He stands in awe of Heaven’s mandate, of great men, and of the words of sages.”

“He arose a hundred generations ago; a hundred generations later, none who hear of him fail to be stirred to action.”

Book of Changes

“He accords in his brightness with the sun and moon.”

“Thus he follows Heaven and responds to the people.”

“Help comes to him from Heaven. Good fortune; nothing is unfavorable. The Master said: ‘To give aid is to help. Those whom Heaven helps are those who accord with it.’”

“It encompasses the Three Powers and doubles them; hence there are six lines.”

Book of Documents

“Kui said: ‘The resonant jade chimes are struck; the drums are beaten, and the qin and se zithers accompany the singing. The ancestral spirits come to us; the guest of Yu is in his place, and the assembled lords yield to one another in virtue. Below the hall, pipes sound and hand drums are beaten; the zhu and yu mark the music’s beginning and end. Mouth organs and great bells sound in alternation, and birds and beasts move rhythmically. When the Xiao Shao music has completed its nine movements, the phoenixes come to grace the ceremony.’ Kui said: ‘Ah! I strike the stone chimes, tapping them gently; all the beasts join in the dance, and the many officials are truly in harmony.’”

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
咸有一德克享天心
皇建其有極斂時五福
乃命寧予以秬鬯二卣曰明禋拜手稽首
休享
詩
采采芣苢薄言袺之采采芣苢薄言襭之
春日遲遲卉木萋萋倉庚喈喈采蘩祁祁
執訊獲醜薄言還歸
君子萬年介爾昭明
===
旣和且平依我磬聲
春秋
夏公會鄭伯于時來〔隱公十有一年〕
夏五月宋人及楚人平〔宣公十有五年〕
秋七月齊侯使國佐如師己酉及國佐
盟于袁婁〔成公二年〕癸丑公會晉侯
衞侯鄭伯曹伯宋世子成齊國佐邾人
同盟于戚〔成公十有五年〕吳子使札
來聘〔襄公二十有九年〕
punctuated:
咸有一德，克享天心。
皇建其有極，斂時五福。
乃命寧予以秬鬯二卣，曰：「明禋。」拜手稽首，休享。

詩
采采芣苢，薄言袺之；采采芣苢，薄言襭之。
春日遲遲，卉木萋萋，倉庚喈喈，采蘩祁祁。
執訊獲醜，薄言還歸。
君子萬年，介爾昭明。
旣和且平，依我磬聲。

春秋
夏，公會鄭伯于時來〔隱公十有一年〕。
夏五月，宋人及楚人平〔宣公十有五年〕。
秋七月，齊侯使國佐如師。己酉，及國佐盟于袁婁〔成公二年〕。
癸丑，公會晉侯、衞侯、鄭伯、曹伯、宋世子成、齊國佐、邾人，同盟于戚〔成公十有五年〕。
吳子使札來聘〔襄公二十有九年〕。
translation_en:
All possess a single virtue and can win acceptance in Heaven’s heart.
The sovereign establishes the supreme standard and gathers these five blessings.
Then [the king] commanded that I be honored with two vessels of fragrant black-millet wine, saying, “For the pure sacrifice.” I bowed with hands joined and forehead to the ground, gratefully receiving the gift.

Book of Odes
We gather, gather the plantain, holding it in our lifted skirts; we gather, gather the plantain, tucking our skirts into our sashes to carry it.
The spring days lengthen; plants and trees grow luxuriantly. Orioles sing in harmony; those gathering white southernwood come in crowds.
We seize prisoners for questioning and capture the enemy host; then we return home.
May our lord live ten thousand years; may you be blessed with shining glory.
Already harmonious and balanced, [the music] follows the sound of our stone chimes.

Spring and Autumn Annals
In summer, the duke met the Earl of Zheng at Shilai. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Yin.〕
In summer, in the fifth month, the men of Song and the men of Chu made peace. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Xuan.〕
In autumn, in the seventh month, the Marquis of Qi sent Guo Zuo to the army. On the jiyou day, a covenant was concluded with Guo Zuo at Yuanlou. 〔Second year of Duke Cheng.〕
On the guichou day, the duke met the Marquis of Jin, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Earl of Cao, Cheng, heir apparent of Song, Guo Zuo of Qi, and representatives of Zhu. Together they entered into a covenant at Qi. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Cheng.〕
The Viscount of Wu sent Zha on a diplomatic visit to our court. 〔Twenty-ninth year of Duke Xiang.〕

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
六月齊侯來獻戎捷〔莊公三十有一年〕
楚人使宜申來獻捷〔僖公二十有一年〕
夏曹公孫會自鄸出奔宋〔昭公二十年〕
禮記
是故天時雨澤君子達亶亶焉
父則天天則神
諸侯有善歸諸天子
臣下竭力盡能以立功於國君必報之以
爵祿故臣下皆務竭力盡能以立功是
===
以國安而君寧
第貳場
論
天之所以爲天
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢詔諸儒講五經異同於石渠閣詔〔甘〕
〔露三年〕
擬唐以裴垍爲中書侍郎同平章事誥〔元〕
〔和三年〕
punctuated:
六月，齊侯來獻戎捷。〔莊公三十有一年〕楚人使宜申來獻捷。〔僖公二十有一年〕夏，曹公孫會自鄸出奔宋。〔昭公二十年〕

禮記
是故天時雨澤，君子達亶亶焉。
父則天，天則神。
諸侯有善，歸諸天子。
臣下竭力盡能，以立功於國，君必報之以爵祿。故臣下皆務竭力盡能，以立功，是以國安而君寧。

第貳場
論
天之所以爲天。

詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢詔諸儒講五經異同於石渠閣詔。〔甘〕〔露三年〕
擬唐以裴垍爲中書侍郎同平章事誥。〔元〕〔和三年〕
translation_en:
In the sixth month, the Marquis of Qi came to present the spoils of victory over the Rong. 〔Thirty-first year of Duke Zhuang〕 The people of Chu sent Yishen to present the spoils of victory. 〔Twenty-first year of Duke Xi〕 In summer, Gongsun Hui of Cao fled from Meng to Song. 〔Twentieth year of Duke Zhao〕

Book of Rites
Thus Heaven sends rain and moisture in due season, and the gentleman attains sincerity [?].
The father takes Heaven as his model; Heaven takes the spirits as its model [?].
When the regional lords accomplish something good, they attribute it to the Son of Heaven.
When subjects exert all their strength and abilities to render service to the state, the ruler must reward them with rank and emoluments. Thus all subjects strive to exert all their strength and abilities to render service; consequently, the state is secure and the ruler is at peace.

Second Session
Discourse
What makes Heaven Heaven.

Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One question in this category [?]〕
Compose an edict in the voice of a Han emperor commanding the Confucian scholars to discuss agreements and differences among the Five Classics at the Shiqu Pavilion. 〔Third year of Ganlu〕
Compose a proclamation in the voice of a Tang emperor appointing Pei Ji as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Participant in Determining Governmental Matters. 〔Third year of Yuanhe〕

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
擬宋以文彥博平章軍□重事謝表〔元祐〕
〔元年〕
判語〔五條〕
磨勘卷宗
脫漏戶口
講讀律令
飛報軍情
教唆詞訟
第叄場
===
策五道
問人君之德莫先於
敬天然而
敬神恤民又皆
敬天之實也祈
天永命實基于此堯舜禹湯文武以來英君誼
辟克盡斯道者誰歟典謨訓誥所載叮
嚀告戒之旨可得聞其詳乎哉
太祖高皇帝肇造區夏
punctuated:
擬宋以文彥博平章軍□重事謝表〔元祐〕〔元年〕。
判語〔五條〕：磨勘卷宗；脫漏戶口；講讀律令；飛報軍情；教唆詞訟。
第叄場
策五道
問：人君之德，莫先於敬天。然而敬神恤民，又皆敬天之實也。祈天永命，實基于此。堯舜禹湯文武以來，英君誼辟克盡斯道者誰歟？典謨訓誥所載叮嚀告戒之旨，可得聞其詳乎哉？太祖高皇帝肇造區夏
translation_en:
Compose a memorial of thanks as if on the occasion when the Song court appointed Wen Yanbo to deliberate on weighty military and other affairs [?]. 〔First year of Yuanyou〕
Legal judgments 〔five topics〕: auditing dossiers; omissions in household and population registration; expounding and studying the statutes and ordinances; urgently reporting military intelligence; instigating litigation.
Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: Among the virtues of a ruler, none takes precedence over reverence for Heaven. Yet revering the spirits and caring for the people are both practical expressions of reverence for Heaven. It is upon these that prayers to Heaven for an enduring mandate truly rest. From the time of Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, and Kings Wen and Wu onward, which enlightened rulers and righteous sovereigns have fully realized this way? May we hear in detail the purport of the earnest admonitions recorded in the Canons, Counsels, Instructions, and Announcements of the Book of Documents? Emperor Taizu Gao founded his realm in the Chinese lands…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
卽位之初首作
皇明祖訓垂示
聖子
神孫及誡諭臣工不一而足莫非主於敬恤我
成祖文皇帝丕纘
洪基原
皇祖之意作
聖學心灋一書序中亹亹數千百言又無非叮
嚀告戒之旨今其書固已昭示宇內炳
===
然與日星竝光可敷陳其蘊乎肆惟我
皇上
龍飛四十年以來其
敬天
敬神
恤民一念精誠篤至有如一日
天語
綸音懃懇諄切
奎章
punctuated: 卽位之初，首作《皇明祖訓》，垂示聖子神孫，及誡諭臣工，不一而足，莫非主於敬恤。我成祖文皇帝丕纘洪基，原皇祖之意，作《聖學心灋》一書，序中亹亹數千百言，又無非叮嚀告戒之旨。今其書固已昭示宇內，炳然與日星竝光，可敷陳其蘊乎？肆惟我皇上龍飛四十年以來，其敬天、敬神、恤民一念，精誠篤至，有如一日。天語綸音，懃懇諄切，奎章
translation_en:
…At the beginning of his reign, he first composed the Ancestral Instructions of the August Ming (Huang Ming zuxun), handing them down for the guidance of his sage sons and divine grandsons. His admonitions to his officials were also too numerous to recount; all centered upon reverence and compassionate care. Our Emperor Wen, Chengzu, magnificently carried forward the great imperial foundation and, following the intentions of his imperial forebear, composed the book Essential Methods of Sagely Learning (Shengxue xinfa). Its preface, earnestly expounding the matter in thousands of words, likewise conveyed nothing but repeated admonitions and warnings. This book has now been made manifest throughout the realm, shining as brilliantly as the sun and stars. Can you expound its deeper meaning?
Now, throughout the forty years since our Emperor ascended the throne, his single-minded reverence for Heaven, reverence for the spirits, and compassionate care for the people have remained utterly sincere and steadfast, as constant as on the first day. His imperial pronouncements and edicts are earnest, solicitous, and emphatic; his imperial compositions…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
宸翰與
二祖之意若合符節而後先焜燿諸士子涵濡
聖化亦既有年于兹矣試為我敷揚以彰
帝德之盛
問薦賢為國藎臣之盛節也然知人則哲
自昔難之則賢之薦也豈易易乎姑以
昔人感遇之異趨者諸生試熟察焉禽
息之擊車其志壯矣而薦牛畜諸賢遂
止歌者之田其所感何速耶祁奚之舉
===
午其心公矣而入蜀惟喜得偉人其所
見何卓耶知人有三難固矣乃以一言
而執手於堂下者果何術歟用賢有五
阻信矣顧以邂逅之遇而獲封於長子
者果何見歟一歲超遷非不知其賢也
何竟以見疎而賦旱雲乎特問郊祀非
不知崇敬也胡廼以難合而賦不遇乎
玉關人老之句固激於有感矣然嘉遁
不出號為人中之龍者孰得而薦之乎
punctuated:
宸翰與二祖之意若合符節，而後先焜燿。諸士子涵濡聖化，亦既有年于兹矣。試為我敷揚，以彰帝德之盛。

問：薦賢為國，藎臣之盛節也。然知人則哲，自昔難之，則賢之薦也，豈易易乎？姑以昔人感遇之異趨者，諸生試熟察焉。禽息之擊車，其志壯矣；而薦牛畜諸賢，遂止歌者之田，其所感何速耶？祁奚之舉午，其心公矣；而入蜀惟喜得偉人，其所見何卓耶？知人有三難，固矣；乃以一言而執手於堂下者，果何術歟？用賢有五阻，信矣；顧以邂逅之遇而獲封於長子者，果何見歟？一歲超遷，非不知其賢也，何竟以見疎而賦《旱雲》乎？特問郊祀，非不知崇敬也，胡廼以難合而賦《不遇》乎？玉關人老之句，固激於有感矣；然嘉遁不出，號為人中之龍者，孰得而薦之乎？
translation_en:
…His Majesty’s imperial writings accord with the intentions of the two ancestral emperors as closely as the matching halves of a tally, their brilliance illuminating successive reigns. You candidates have by now been steeped in the sage sovereign’s transforming influence for many years. Expound upon this for us, to make manifest the fullness of imperial virtue.

Question: Recommending worthy men to serve the state is an outstanding act of loyal ministers. Yet discerning men constitutes wisdom, and this has been considered difficult since antiquity. Can recommending worthy men, then, be easy? Consider carefully the differing courses by which men of former times responded to recognition and opportunity.

When Qin Xi struck the carriage, his resolve was heroic. Yet when Niu Xu and other worthy men were recommended, the carriage stopped at a singer’s field [?]. How was the response so swift? When Qi Xi recommended Wu, his intentions were impartial. Yet the man who entered Shu rejoiced only in obtaining outstanding men. How exceptional was his discernment?

That discerning men involves three difficulties is certainly true. Yet what method did the man employ who, upon hearing a single utterance, took the speaker’s hand below the hall? That employing worthy men encounters five obstacles is indeed true. Yet what insight led to someone receiving an enfeoffment at Zhangzi through a chance encounter?

Promotion by exceptional advances within a single year surely showed recognition of the recipient’s worth. Why, then, did he ultimately compose “Drought Clouds” upon becoming estranged from his patron? A special inquiry about the suburban sacrifices surely showed an understanding of reverence. Why, then, did he compose “Failure to Find Recognition” because he could not find acceptance?

The line about a man growing old at the Jade Pass certainly arose from deeply stirred feelings. Yet who could secure the opportunity to recommend the man who withdrew honorably and would not come forth, known as a dragon among men?

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
感賦明河之篇固憤於所遇矣然屢辟
不就號爲百世之師者孰得而舉之耶
是數子者或以知遇而致身於青雲或
以偃蹇而甘委於溝壑是非得失必有
一居此者諸士尚論古人久矣願悉陳
之以觀素蘊
問漢人有言郎官出宰百里上應列宿又
曰庶民所以安其田里而無愁苦嘆息
之聲者其惟良二千石乎由此則守令
繫於民亦大矣封建以前靡可得稽矣
漢更秦弊與民休息而漢世良吏號稱
獨盛故其民亦安平無事而當時賢者
亦美之曰郡縣守令民之師帥其意何
所指歟今之民亦孔棘矣仳離愁苦之
狀至有不忍言者豈守令者果未得其
人乎夫今之民即三代之民也大江以
西歷代良吏彬彬汗史有如惠浹江湖
而號番君下榻而賓禮高士民歌何父
punctuated:
感賦明河之篇，固憤於所遇矣；然屢辟不就，號爲百世之師者，孰得而舉之耶？是數子者，或以知遇而致身於青雲，或以偃蹇而甘委於溝壑。是非得失，必有一居此者。諸士尚論古人久矣，願悉陳之，以觀素蘊。

問：漢人有言：「郎官出宰百里，上應列宿。」又曰：「庶民所以安其田里，而無愁苦嘆息之聲者，其惟良二千石乎！」由此則守令繫於民亦大矣。封建以前，靡可得稽矣。漢更秦弊，與民休息，而漢世良吏號稱獨盛，故其民亦安平無事。而當時賢者亦美之曰：「郡縣守令，民之師帥。」其意何所指歟？今之民亦孔棘矣，仳離愁苦之狀，至有不忍言者。豈守令者果未得其人乎？夫今之民，即三代之民也。大江以西，歷代良吏彬彬汗史，有如惠浹江湖而號番君，下榻而賓禮高士，民歌何父
translation_en:
…The feelings that prompted the composition of the poem “The Milky Way” surely arose from indignation at the treatment received. Yet who could recommend the man who repeatedly declined summonses to office and was acclaimed as a teacher for a hundred generations? Of these several men, some rose to lofty office through recognition and patronage; others, proud and unbending, willingly consigned themselves to destitution. In terms of right and wrong, gain and loss, each must have his place. You gentlemen have long discussed and appraised the ancients. Please set forth your views fully, so that we may discern the understanding you have cultivated.

Question: Someone in the Han said: “When a Court Gentleman goes out to govern a district of a hundred li, he corresponds above to the constellations.” It was also said: “If the common people dwell peacefully in their fields and villages, without cries of sorrow or sighs of distress, is this not due to good officials of the two-thousand-bushel rank?” From this, it is clear that prefects and magistrates have a great bearing on the people’s welfare. Conditions before the establishment of the enfeoffment system cannot be verified. The Han reformed the abuses of the Qin and allowed the people rest and recuperation. Good officials were reputed to be exceptionally numerous under the Han, and thus its people also enjoyed peace and freedom from trouble. Worthy men of the time praised them, saying: “The governors of commanderies and magistrates of counties are the people’s teachers and leaders.” What did they mean by this?

The people today are also in dire straits. Some instances of families being torn apart, sorrow, and suffering are unbearable even to recount. Can it really be that the right men have not been found to serve as prefects and magistrates? The people today are, after all, the same as the people of the Three Dynasties. West of the great Yangzi River, good officials of successive dynasties appear in distinguished succession in the historical records. Among them were one whose beneficence pervaded the rivers and lakes and who was called the Lord of Po; one who lowered a couch to receive a lofty scholar with the courtesies due a guest; and one whom the people celebrated in song as “Father He”…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
感賦明河之篇固憤於所遇矣然屢辟
不就號爲百世之師者孰得而舉之耶
是數子者或以知遇而致身於靑雲或
以偃蹇而甘委於溝壑是非得失必有
一居此者諸士尚論古人久矣願悉陳
之以觀素蘊
問漢人有言郎官出宰百里上應列宿又
曰庶民所以安其田里而無愁苦嘆息
之聲者其惟良二千石乎由此則守令
===
繫於民亦大矣封建以前靡可得稽矣
漢更秦弊與民休息而漢世良吏號稱
獨盛故其民亦安平無事而當時賢者
亦美之曰郡縣守令民之師帥其意何
所指歟今之民亦孔棘矣仳離愁苦之
狀至有不忍言者豈守令者果未得其
人乎夫今之民卽三代之民也大江以
西歷代良吏彬彬汗史有如惠泱江湖
而號番君下榻而賓禮高士民歌何父
punctuated:
感賦《明河》之篇，固憤於所遇矣。然屢辟不就，號爲百世之師者，孰得而舉之耶？是數子者，或以知遇而致身於靑雲，或以偃蹇而甘委於溝壑，是非得失，必有一居此者。諸士尚論古人久矣，願悉陳之，以觀素蘊。

問：漢人有言：「郎官出宰百里，上應列宿。」又曰：「庶民所以安其田里而無愁苦嘆息之聲者，其惟良二千石乎！」由此則守令繫於民亦大矣。封建以前，靡可得稽矣。漢更秦弊，與民休息，而漢世良吏號稱獨盛，故其民亦安平無事。而當時賢者亦美之曰：「郡縣守令，民之師帥。」其意何所指歟？今之民亦孔棘矣，仳離愁苦之狀，至有不忍言者，豈守令者果未得其人乎？夫今之民卽三代之民也。大江以西，歷代良吏彬彬汗史，有如惠泱江湖而號番君，下榻而賓禮高士，民歌何父
translation_en:
…Moved to compose the poem “The Bright River” (Minghe), he was surely indignant at his treatment. Yet who can name the man who repeatedly declined summonses to office and was acclaimed as a teacher for a hundred generations? Of these several men, some rose to lofty office through receiving recognition and patronage, while others, proud and unbending, willingly consigned themselves to destitution. Right or wrong, gain or loss—one of these judgments must apply in each case. You gentlemen have long discussed the men of antiquity. Set forth your views fully, so that we may discern the understanding you have cultivated.

Question: A man of the Han said: “When Gentlemen go out to govern districts a hundred li across, they correspond above to the arrayed stars.” It was also said: “That ordinary people dwell peacefully in their fields and villages, without sounds of sorrowful sighing—is this not owing to good officials of the two-thousand-bushel rank?” Thus prefects and magistrates have a great bearing on the lives of the people. For the period before the establishment of hereditary fiefs, nothing can be verified. The Han reformed the abuses of the Qin and allowed the people rest and recuperation. Good officials were reputed to flourish especially under the Han, and consequently its people lived peacefully and without disturbance. Worthies of that time also praised them, saying: “Prefects and magistrates are the teachers and leaders of the people.” What did they mean by this?

The people today, too, are in dire straits. Their separation from their families, sorrow, and suffering are sometimes unbearable even to describe. Can it really be that suitable men have not been found to serve as prefects and magistrates? The people of today are, after all, the same as the people of the Three Dynasties. West of the Great River, good officials of successive ages appear in splendid profusion in the historical records. Among them were one whose beneficence spread throughout the rivers and lakes [?], earning him the title Lord of Po; one who lowered a couch to receive a lofty scholar with the courtesies due a guest; and one whom the people celebrated in song as “Father He”…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
非以其築隄防之功乎感惠立祠非以
其漑陂田之蹟乎代贖男女七百餘人
果何術以濟之歟召戒諸縣使之自相
爲治何以得其理歟興學賑饑視愛民
如子俸外一無所取者果有同乎孜孜
愛民比之卓魯視正直廉潔郡人感悦
者亦有別乎玆數公者果可爲守令灋
程歟有宋理學諸臣均牧玆土者也治
行章章可得而數之乎往歲言官建白
===
時艱皆云守令不靖所致
上命監司汰其甚者郡邑長吏惕惕焉奉法矣
玆欲爲久安之計多方以風之俾其良
而無忝於前聞將何施而可願悉著于
篇以觀尚志之學
問聖人設教勸民以獲實欲賢雋竝興如
魚鱗鳳翼雜沓參差不絕於世則循名
責實亦聖人之所不廢也故曰人主爲
社稷計唯恐士之不好名則名固爲治
punctuated:
非以其築隄防之功乎？感惠立祠，非以其漑陂田之蹟乎？代贖男女七百餘人，果何術以濟之歟？召戒諸縣，使之自相爲治，何以得其理歟？興學賑饑，視愛民如子，俸外一無所取者，果有同乎？孜孜愛民，比之卓魯，視正直廉潔、郡人感悦者，亦有別乎？玆數公者，果可爲守令灋程歟？有宋理學諸臣，均牧玆土者也，治行章章，可得而數之乎？往歲言官建白，時艱皆云守令不靖所致。上命監司汰其甚者，郡邑長吏惕惕焉奉法矣。玆欲爲久安之計，多方以風之，俾其良而無忝於前聞，將何施而可？願悉著于篇，以觀尚志之學。

問：聖人設教，勸民以獲實，欲賢雋竝興，如魚鱗鳳翼，雜沓參差，不絕於世，則循名責實，亦聖人之所不廢也。故曰：「人主爲社稷計，唯恐士之不好名。」則名固爲治
translation_en:
…was this not because of his achievements in building dikes? When people established a shrine in gratitude for another’s beneficence, was this not because of his work in irrigating embanked fields? By what means did the man who paid to redeem more than seven hundred men and women accomplish their deliverance? Another summoned and admonished the county officials, having them undertake local governance themselves: how did he arrive at the proper principles of government? Was the man who promoted schools and relieved famine indeed like the one who loved the people as his children and took nothing beyond his salary? Was the man who tirelessly loved the people and was compared to Zhuo and Lu also different from the upright, incorruptible man whom the people of his prefecture gratefully admired? Can these gentlemen indeed serve as models for prefects and county magistrates? The Song ministers versed in the Learning of Principle all governed this land. Can their illustrious achievements in office be enumerated?

In past years, remonstrance officials submitted representations, all attributing the difficulties of the times to prefects and county magistrates failing to maintain order. His Majesty ordered the surveillance commissioners to dismiss the worst offenders, and the chief officials of prefectures and counties have since upheld the law with fearful vigilance. Now, wishing to devise a plan for lasting peace and to influence them through various means, so that they become good officials and do not disgrace the reputation of their predecessors, what measures should be taken? Set this out fully in your essay, so that we may assess your learning in the cultivation of lofty aspirations.

Question: The sages established their teachings and encouraged the people to achieve substantive results, wishing worthy and talented men to arise together, like fish scales and phoenix wings, densely arrayed in varied ranks, never ceasing to appear in the world. Thus, judging actual achievement against reputation was also something the sages never abandoned. Hence the saying: “When the ruler plans for the altars of soil and grain, his only fear is that scholars will not cherish a good name.” Reputation, then, is surely, in governing…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
所先矣又有以采名不采實爲國家之
患者何與又謂求士於三代之上唯恐
其好名求士於三代之下唯恐其不好
名夫循名責實一也又何以有古今之
異與得御李君者以登龍爲喜不見趙
咨者以貽笑爲愧葵扇留題價增數倍
練布初裁市價騰湧當時習俗可謂以
聲名相尚矣世道之隆汚亦有可得言
者與或有性好人倫稱述過多日不加
===
美言則聲名不足慕而爲善者少是奬
進人材唯恐名之不足矣然賣藥長安
女子知名者復入霸陵山以避之則所
以自處者又嫌於近名何與昔之人或
汲引後進推挽成就有訾其好名者則
曰使夫人而避此則爲善之路絶矣或
恤孤賑窮薦達人物有譏其好名者曰
若避好名之嫌人不敢復爲善矣則又
未嘗以名爲諱也是果何説與善乎莊
punctuated: 所先矣。又有以采名不采實爲國家之患者，何與？又謂求士於三代之上，唯恐其好名；求士於三代之下，唯恐其不好名。夫循名責實，一也，又何以有古今之異與？得御李君者，以登龍爲喜；不見趙咨者，以貽笑爲愧。葵扇留題，價增數倍；練布初裁，市價騰湧。當時習俗，可謂以聲名相尚矣。世道之隆汚，亦有可得言者與？或有性好人倫，稱述過多，日：「不加美言，則聲名不足慕，而爲善者少。」是奬進人材，唯恐名之不足矣。然賣藥長安，女子知名者，復入霸陵山以避之，則所以自處者，又嫌於近名，何與？昔之人，或汲引後進，推挽成就，有訾其好名者，則曰：「使夫人而避此，則爲善之路絶矣。」或恤孤賑窮，薦達人物，有譏其好名者，曰：「若避好名之嫌，人不敢復爲善矣。」則又未嘗以名爲諱也。是果何説與？善乎莊
translation_en:
…what takes priority in governing. Yet some regard attending to reputation rather than actual worth as a danger to the state. Why is this? It is also said that, when seeking worthy men in the Three Dynasties and earlier, the chief concern was that they might love reputation; when seeking them after the Three Dynasties, the chief concern was that they might not love reputation. Examining reputation and demanding corresponding substance is the same principle throughout: why, then, this difference between antiquity and later times?

Those who gained the chance to drive Master Li’s carriage rejoiced as though they had ascended the Dragon Gate; those who failed to meet Zhao Zi felt ashamed of exposing themselves to ridicule. When an inscription was left on a palm-leaf fan, its price increased severalfold; when dressed silk cloth was first cut [?], its market price soared. The customs of that time may indeed be described as valuing people and things according to reputation. Can anything also be said about the flourishing or decline of the moral order on this basis?

There was someone naturally fond of appraising people, who praised them excessively, saying [?]: “Without flattering words, reputation would not be sufficiently attractive, and fewer people would do good.” Thus, in encouraging and advancing talented men, his only fear was that their reputation might be insufficient. Yet a man selling medicine in Chang’an, when a woman learned his name, withdrew again into the mountains of Baling to evade recognition. In conducting his own life, he was wary even of approaching fame. Why was this?

Among men of former times, one drew forward younger men and helped them attain success. When someone censured him for loving reputation, he replied: “If everyone avoided this, the path to doing good would be cut off.” Another cared for orphans, relieved the poor, and recommended worthy people for advancement. When someone mocked him for loving reputation, he said: “If people avoided the suspicion of loving reputation, they would no longer dare to do good.” Thus neither treated reputation as something to shun. What, indeed, explains this? How well Zhuang…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
生有言實者名之主名者實之賓也玆
欲士之所以自持審擇於二斯者而知
所輕重
國家之所以取士斟酌於斯二者而知所折
衷名實參而由焉其道何居願詳言之
以觀為己之學
問古人謂豐世無盜者足也治世無盜者
均也是固然矣然書稱寇賊姦宄自唐
虞蓋已有之邇者閩廣谿峒海島之民
===
煽結為盜江右唇齒之國也罹其荼毒
數矣皆謂歲歉艱食所致則當其事者
何不能消弭於未形又不過絕其始萌
而使滋蔓於鄰國與今之言弭盜者多
矣舉而行之猶拾瀋也其計將安出與
夫聚兵則散走罷兵則復集此禦盜之
難山谷阻深草木蓊翳此追盜之難彼
鈔掠村落以飽待饑我前蘇後爨兵不
宿飽此糧餉之難羣惡甘為賊黨編氓
punctuated:
生有言：「實者名之主，名者實之賓也。」玆欲士之所以自持，審擇於二斯者而知所輕重；國家之所以取士，斟酌於斯二者而知所折衷。名實參而由焉，其道何居？願詳言之，以觀為己之學。

問：古人謂：「豐世無盜者，足也；治世無盜者，均也。」是固然矣。然書稱「寇賊姦宄」，自唐虞蓋已有之。邇者閩廣谿峒海島之民，煽結為盜。江右唇齒之國也，罹其荼毒數矣。皆謂歲歉艱食所致，則當其事者何不能消弭於未形，又不過絕其始萌，而使滋蔓於鄰國與？今之言弭盜者多矣，舉而行之，猶拾瀋也，其計將安出與？夫聚兵則散走，罷兵則復集，此禦盜之難；山谷阻深，草木蓊翳，此追盜之難；彼鈔掠村落，以飽待饑，我前蘇後爨，兵不宿飽，此糧餉之難；羣惡甘為賊黨，編氓
translation_en:
…Master Zhuang said: “Substance is the master of reputation; reputation is the guest of substance.” Now, in conducting themselves, scholars should carefully weigh these two and understand their relative importance; in selecting scholars, the state should consider both and understand how to strike the proper balance. What is the way to assess reputation and substance together and proceed accordingly? Explain this fully, so that we may observe your learning undertaken for your own moral cultivation.

Question: The ancients said: “Prosperous ages have no bandits because there is sufficiency; well-governed ages have no bandits because there is equitable distribution.” This is certainly so. Yet the Book of Documents speaks of “robbers, thieves, and wrongdoers within and without”: they evidently existed as early as the reigns of Yao and Shun. Recently, inhabitants of the ravines, mountain settlements, and offshore islands of Min and Guang have incited one another and banded together as bandits. Jiangyou, a region as closely connected to these as lips and teeth, has repeatedly suffered their ravages. Everyone attributes this to poor harvests and difficulty obtaining food. Why, then, have those responsible been unable to eliminate the trouble before it took shape, or cut it off at its first beginnings [?], instead allowing it to spread into neighboring regions? Many now speak of suppressing banditry, but putting their proposals into practice is like trying to gather spilled liquid. What plan, then, should be devised?

When troops are concentrated, the bandits scatter and flee; when troops are withdrawn, they gather again: this is the difficulty of defending against bandits. Mountains and valleys are rugged and deep, and vegetation grows densely: this is the difficulty of pursuing bandits. They plunder villages and, well fed, await our hungry troops; we must first gather fuel [?] and then cook, and our soldiers cannot remain adequately fed: this is the difficulty of provisioning the army. The multitude of malefactors willingly join the bandits, while registered commoners…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
迫於脅從執訊獻馘玉石罔辨此處□
之難凡此數者何以處之與陣而後戰
此古法也羣盜戰無行伍聚不成列唯
專事設伏與分兵掩襲耳則古法亦可
用於今否與摧堅陷陣莫若火器而製
之不善用之不精則反為害今之火器
果盡善而無可議與射疏及遠莫若弓
弩或謂山峒射生之徒毒藥傅矢射能
命中為江右長技亦可藉之以克敵否
===
與五兵之用各有相宜彼此相制缺一
不可今郡邑兵器唯多用長槍長槍亦
可以專用與唐之跳盪宋之背嵬皆選
鋒之說也今之所謂精兵常兵者亦可
以倣此與或謂軍兵民兵皆不足賴而
欲行調募之法調募之與土着二者為
孰得與或謂弭盜之法在行保甲或謂
弭盜之法在擇守令二者果孰要與或
謂盜所從來者閩廣也不合數省之兵
punctuated: 迫於脅從，執訊獻馘，玉石罔辨，此處□之難。凡此數者，何以處之與？陣而後戰，此古法也。羣盜戰無行伍，聚不成列，唯專事設伏與分兵掩襲耳，則古法亦可用於今否與？摧堅陷陣，莫若火器；而製之不善，用之不精，則反為害。今之火器，果盡善而無可議與？射疏及遠，莫若弓弩。或謂山峒射生之徒，毒藥傅矢，射能命中，為江右長技，亦可藉之以克敵否與？五兵之用，各有相宜，彼此相制，缺一不可。今郡邑兵器，唯多用長槍，長槍亦可以專用與？唐之跳盪、宋之背嵬，皆選鋒之說也。今之所謂精兵、常兵者，亦可以倣此與？或謂軍兵、民兵皆不足賴，而欲行調募之法。調募之與土着，二者為孰得與？或謂弭盜之法在行保甲，或謂弭盜之法在擇守令，二者果孰要與？或謂盜所從來者閩廣也，不合數省之兵
translation_en:
…are coerced into following them. When prisoners are taken for interrogation and severed ears presented as proof of kills, jade and stone—the innocent and the guilty—are not distinguished. This is the difficulty of dealing with □ [?]. How should these several difficulties be addressed?

To draw up formations before fighting was the ancient method. Bands of brigands fight without organized ranks and assemble without forming lines; they concentrate solely on laying ambushes and dividing their forces for surprise attacks. Can the ancient method still be applied today? Nothing surpasses firearms for breaking strong defenses and penetrating enemy formations. Yet if poorly made or inexpertly used, they instead cause harm. Are today's firearms truly all so well made as to leave no room for criticism? For shooting at scattered targets and reaching distant ones, nothing surpasses bows and crossbows. Some say that hunters in the mountain valleys coat their arrows with poison and can hit their targets, and that this is a particular strength of Jiangyou. Could this skill also be used to defeat the enemy?

Each of the five kinds of weapons has its appropriate use; they counter one another, and none can be dispensed with. Yet among the weapons used in today's prefectures and counties, long spears predominate. Can long spears be used exclusively? The Tang dynasty's Tiaodang assault troops and the Song dynasty's Beiwei troops both exemplify the selection of elite vanguards. Could today's so-called elite troops and ordinary troops also be organized on this model? Some say that neither regular soldiers nor militia can be relied upon, and wish to adopt a system of transferring and recruiting troops. Which is preferable: troops transferred and recruited from elsewhere, or local men? Some say that the way to suppress brigandage lies in implementing the baojia system of mutual household responsibility; others say that it lies in choosing prefects and magistrates. Which of these is truly more important? Some say that the brigands come from Fujian and Guangdong, and that unless the forces of several provinces are combined…

title: 嘉靖四十年江西鄉試錄
text:
草薙而禽蒐之則三省之民未得息肩
果爲方今之首務否與文事武備皆儒
者所當究心諸生生長是邦已稔聞而
熟計之願聞窮源探本之論以爲永保
無虞之圖使主司者採焉
punctuated: 草薙而禽蒐之，則三省之民未得息肩，果爲方今之首務否與？文事武備，皆儒者所當究心。諸生生長是邦，已稔聞而熟計之，願聞窮源探本之論，以爲永保無虞之圖，使主司者採焉。
translation_en: …to cut them down like grass and hunt them like game, the people of the three provinces will find no respite. Is this indeed the foremost task at present? Civil affairs and military preparedness are both matters to which Confucian scholars should devote careful thought. You candidates were born and raised in this province; you have heard much about these matters and considered them thoroughly. We wish to hear arguments that trace their sources and probe their roots, providing a plan for lasting security that those presiding over this examination may adopt.
